title: INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS OPTIMIZATION
description: A first course in operations research. Topics include mathematical programming formulations and solutions, the simplex method, network optimization, introduction to metaheuristics, and linear programming under uncertainty.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (IE 255 or ST 314) and (MTH 306, 306H, 341, 264 or 264H).
A minimum grade of C is required in IE 255, ST 314, MTH 306, MTH 306H, MTH 341, MTH 264 and MTH 264H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
